{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Correct assay_batch B values: divide by 10 to convert from µg/L to ng/mL
deduplicated_data['biomarker_final_corrected'] = deduplicated_data['biomarker_final']
deduplicated_data.loc[deduplicated_data['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Compute the mean of biomarker_final_corrected across all patients
mean_biomarker_final = deduplicated_data['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()

# Extract and print the raw (uncorrected) batch B values for verification
batch_b_raw_values = deduplicated_data[deduplicated_data['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final']
batch_b_raw_sample = batch_b_raw_values.sample(5)
batch_b_raw_values_list = batch_b_raw_values.tolist()

# Compute and print the corrected values (should be 1/10th of raw)
batch_b_corrected_sample = deduplicated_data[deduplicated_data['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final_corrected'].sample(5)

print(f"Mean biomarker_final (corrected for assay_batch B) across all patients: {mean_biomarker_final}")
print(f"\nSample of raw batch B values (before correction):\n{batch_b_raw_sample}")
print(f"\nSample of corrected batch B values (after division by 10):\n{batch_b_corrected_sample}")
print(f"\nRaw batch B values (to verify scaling): {batch_b_raw_values_list[:5]}")"}
